maria: Quick question — we received 3 applications for the SI Trainer Fellowship. Can we do a quick sync on acceptance criteria?
lee: Yep. We should use the rubric from last quarter + a live shadow requirement. cc @devon for logistics and @sarah for SI intake details.
devon: I can coordinate shadow days. Need approved list and whether we run remote or on-site shadows. Also any special HW access? :eyes: 
sarah: Candidates: Amit Sharma (completed labs + demo), Priya K. (strong PM background, needs sandbox access), Jose M. (applied, limited infra experience). We requested creds for Priya this morning.
maria: Proposed decision: accept Amit full, accept Priya conditional on sandbox pass within 7 days, defer Jose for next cohort. Thoughts? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
lee: +1 to that. For Priya let's assign a training buddy and schedule a 2-hr hands-on. Can we do cohort kickoff next Mon?
devon: I'll create onboarding ticket and calendar invites. onboard-bot: Created ticket RW-8721 for "Trainer Fellowship - cohort 2024-11 intake" and scheduled shadow slots (links: https://zoom.redwood/rw-8721).
maria: Drafted acceptance email — use this template (feel free to tweak):
```
Subject: Redwood SI Trainer Fellowship — Acceptance
Hi <Name>,

Congrats — we'd like to invite you to the Redwood SI Trainer Fellowship. Next steps:
1) Complete sandbox pass: follow labs at https://labs.redwood/si-sandbox (deadline 7 days)
2) Join cohort kickoff: Mon Nov 4, 10:00am PT (Zoom link below)
3) Sign trainer agreement and NDA (attached)

Please confirm availability and we'll send calendar invites.

Welcome!
— Maria (Partnerships)
```
lee: I'll attach the trainer agreement and NDA from Google Drive and send calendar invites once Priya's sandbox access is confirmed.
maria: Awesome — devon flag any infra requests here (gpu access, network allowlist). Thanks team!
